user.title: EV Solar Manager
user.description: Sensors used to calculate the solar surplus and the entity that sets the charging current.

data_description.power_entity: Net power at the grid meter in W (already includes the charger load).
data_description.export_is_negative: On when the grid power sensor is negative while exporting solar surplus.
data_description.voltage_entity: Grid voltage in V, used to convert watts to amperes.
data_description.target_number: Number entity that sets the charger's maximum current (A).

charger.title: Charger
charger.description: Optional charger entities. Without a status sensor the current is recalculated continuously and automatic stop/start is disabled.

data_description.charger_power_entity: Optional. Real charger power in W (e.g. a Shelly EM channel). Improves the start of regulation and limits the setpoint when the car draws less.
data_description.charger_status_entity: Optional. Recalculation then runs only while charging; required for automatic stop/start.
data_description.charger_start_stop_button: Optional. Toggle button used to stop charging when there is no surplus and to restart when it returns. Requires the status sensor.

states.title: Charger status values
states.description: Pick the status values reported by the charger status sensor, or type them. Check them in Developer Tools → States.

data_description.charging_state: Status value while the car is charging (case-sensitive).
data_description.stopped_state: Status value after the start/stop button stopped charging (case-sensitive).

tuning.title: Regulation
tuning.description: Current limits, timing and anti-flapping parameters. The defaults suit most installations.

data_description.min_current: Lowest charging current. IEC 61851 does not allow less than 6 A.
data_description.max_current: Highest charging current the controller may set.
data_description.phases: Number of phases the car charges on.
data_description.safety_margin_w: Power kept as grid export while charging (safety margin).
data_description.update_interval: How often the charging current is recalculated.
data_description.min_delta_amp: Smaller changes are not written to the charger (noise suppression).
data_description.start_hysteresis_w: Extra surplus, above the minimum-current power, needed to restart after a stop.
data_description.stop_delay_s: The surplus must stay too low this long before charging is stopped.
data_description.start_delay_s: The surplus must stay high enough this long before charging is restarted.

error.button_needs_status: The start/stop button is a toggle: it needs the charger status sensor to know whether a press starts or stops charging.
error.max_below_min: The maximum current must not be lower than the minimum current.
error.min_current_too_low: IEC 61851 does not allow less than 6 A.

abort.already_configured: EV Solar Manager is already configured.
abort.single_instance_allowed: EV Solar Manager is already configured. Use Configure to change its settings.
